europe_now.title: Ukraine-Russia conflict escalation with overnight strikes
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian drones and missiles targeted Russian regions overnight, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. The conflict shows no signs of de-escalation, with both sides exchanging deadly attacks.

sources.headline: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian strike on Russia's Tatarstan region, officials say

europe_now.title: Wildfires in Southern France forcing evacuations
europe_now.summary: A major wildfire in southern France has prompted mass evacuations and disrupted local infrastructure. The fire is linked to extreme heat conditions, highlighting climate-related risks in the region.

sources.headline: Wildfire rages in southern France, forcing evacuations

top_stories.title: Western Europe's record-breaking heatwave and wildfires
top_stories.summary: Western Europe experienced its hottest June and July on record, exacerbating drought conditions and wildfire risks. Southern France's wildfire has forced evacuations, underscoring climate extremes.

sources.headline: Western Europe records hottest June and July on record

top_stories.title: Geopolitical tensions in Ceuta and Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Spain initiated border checks on Italy over the Ceuta migration dispute, escalating regional tensions. Concurrently, Ukraine-Russia strikes continue, with recent attacks causing significant casualties.
